context: Sakura uses voice transcription for the first time; quick test.
purpose: Adult writer adopting new productivity tool.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 蓮くん、声、入力、本当にできるの?
lines.en: Ren — can you really do voice input?
lines.style: Curious, testing tone. Leans forward slightly. Soft warmth underneath the skepticism. Genuine interest in how he'll answer, not doubt.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.style: Quiet encouragement. Calm, unhurried. The ease of someone who's confident but not showing off. A small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: すごい、ちゃんと、変換した!
lines.en: Whoa — it actually converted it properly!
lines.style: Genuine surprise and delight. Eyebrows up. Quick bright laugh on the opening. Wonder at something small working exactly right.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.style: Warm, easy. A small knowing smile — he was right. Not gloating, just the quiet satisfaction of sharing something useful with someone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Soft, appreciative. She's already imagining using this. Relaxed into the moment. The contentment of a small discovery that changes something about your day.
